name: talk-trace
description: Records what your Mac plays, plus your microphone
author: Muhamad Iqbal

scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p dist/renderer/icons && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/tokens.css src/renderer/style.css dist/renderer/ && cp src/renderer/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/icons/
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: pnpm run build:helper && pnpm run build:transcriber && pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:copy
